from datetime import datetime
import os

# Ensure we have by_trip computed from previous step; if not, recompute with minimal extra reads.
# We'll try to reuse existing by_trip + fs_token + vacations_dir.

if 'by_trip' in globals() and isinstance(by_trip, dict) and all(k in by_trip for k in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']):
    print('reusing_by_trip', {k: len(by_trip[k]) for k in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']})
else:
    print('recomputing_by_trip')
    # Login to file_system if needed
    if 'fs_token' not in globals() or not fs_token:
        passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
        fs_pass = next(p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name']=='file_system')
        fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=fs_pass).get('access_token')
    vacations_dir = '~/photographs/vacations/'
    files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=vacations_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
    current_year = datetime.now().year
    from collections import defaultdict
    by_trip = defaultdict(list)
    for fp in files:
        info = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=fp)
        created_at = info.get('created_at')
        dt = datetime.fromisoformat(created_at.replace('Z','+00:00')) if created_at else None
        month = dt.month if dt else None
        year = dt.year if dt else None
        if year == current_year and month == 1:
            by_trip['Athens'].append(fp)
        elif year == current_year and month == 4:
            by_trip['Seoul'].append(fp)
        else:
            by_trip['Paris'].append(fp)

# Define source and destination directories
vacations_dir = '~/photographs/vacations/'
spot_dirs = {spot: f"{vacations_dir}{spot}/" for spot in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']}

# Check/create destination directories (skip if exists)
if 'fs_token' not in globals() or not fs_token:
    passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
    fs_pass = next(p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name']=='file_system')
    fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='susanmiller@gmail.com', password=fs_pass).get('access_token')

for spot, dpath in spot_dirs.items():
    exists = apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dpath).get('exists', False)
    print('dir_exists', spot, dpath, exists)
    if not exists:
        res = apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dpath, recursive=True)
        print('created_dir', spot, res)

# Move files, preserving names
moves = []
for spot, files in by_trip.items():
    for src_path in files:
        fname = src_path.split('/')[-1]
        dest_path = f"{vacations_dir}{spot}/{fname}"
        # Attempt move
        out = apis.file_system.move_file(
            access_token=fs_token,
            source_file_path=src_path,
            destination_file_path=dest_path
        )
        moves.append((spot, fname, src_path, out.get('destination_file_path')))

print('moves_count', len(moves))
print('moves_sample', moves[:3])

# Verification: source folder should have 0 files; destination folders should contain expected counts
source_files_after = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=vacations_dir, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
print('source_files_after_count', len(source_files_after))

for spot in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris']:
    dpath = spot_dirs[spot]
    files_after = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=dpath, entry_type='files', recursive=False)
    print('dest_count', spot, len(files_after))

# Also verify total
expected_total = sum(len(by_trip[s]) for s in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris'])
actual_total_dest = sum(apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=spot_dirs[s], entry_type='files', recursive=False).__len__() for s in ['Athens','Seoul','Paris'])
print('expected_total', expected_total, 'actual_total_dest', actual_total_dest)
